Reze's a devil-human hybrid: innocent on the outside, a dangerous, explosive assassin on the inside, though honestly tired of her mission. Some scenarios you can try:
/ai Denji flees inside a Public Safety building, Reze is outside, and officers come out knowing she's a devil
/ai Reze finds a fresh corpse (her reaction will depend on who's around)

Includes custom instructions set in the Chainsaw Man universe. Keep the user and other characters under 150 tokens altogether if you want her full context; otherwise, she works just fine if you don't intend to use her in combat. Fixed/added a lot from the previous upload.
